name: Non Compliant Solidcore Agents
description: This report lists Solidcore agents that are in Disabled, Update, and Observe mode or where local CLI access is recovered. Agents in Disabled, Update, and Observe mode provide limited Change Control functionality on the client. Trellix ePO policy and task enforcement is suspended on clients where local CLI is recovered.
conditionSexp: (Compliance Status Equals Non Compliant and Change Control License Value is not blank  and Change Control Equals True)

name: Policy Details
description: Displays information of all the rules assigned to Integrity Monitor and Change Control policy.
conditionSexp: Policy Name Equals ""

name: Change Events grouped by Reconciliation Status in the Last 1 Month
description: Displays a pie chart of events in the last 1 month organized by whether the change event has been reconciled against a change ticket or not. Reconciled changes are shown as authorized and unreconciled changes are shown as unauthorized.
conditionSexp: Event Generated Time Is within the last 1 Months

name: Policy Assignments By System
description: Displays a list of all Solidcore policy assignments on systems.
conditionSexp: (Product Equals Solidcore 8.4.5:Integrity Monitor or Product Equals Solidcore 8.4.5:Change Control or Product Equals Solidcore 8.4.5:General)

description: PCI Section 10.3 - Displays the summary of changes grouped by Programs.
conditionSexp: (Event Generated Time Is within the last 3 Months and (Event Name Starts with "FILE_CREATED" or Event Name Equals "FILE_READ_UPDATE" or Event Name Starts with "FILE_DELETED" or Event Name Starts with "FILE_MODIFIED" or Event Name Starts with "FILE_RENAMED" or Event Name Starts with "FILE_ATTR_CLEAR" or Event Name Starts with "FILE_ATTR_SET" or Event Name Starts with "FILE_ATTR_MODIFIED" or Event Name Starts with "ACL_MODIFIED" or Event Name Starts with "STREAM_ATTR_CLEAR" or Event Name Starts with "STREAM_ATTR_MODIFIED" or Event Name Starts with "STREAM_ATTR_SET" or Event Name Starts with "STREAM_CREATED" or Event Name Starts with "STREAM_DELETED" or Event Name Starts with "STREAM_MODIFIED" or Event Name Starts with "REG_KEY_CREATED" or Event Name Starts with "REG_KEY_DELETED" or Event Name Starts with "REG_VALUE_DELETED" or Event Name Starts with "REG_VALUE_MODIFIED") and (Process Name Value is not blank  and Process Name Does not contain "McAfee"))

conditionSexp: ((Event Name Starts with "FILE_MODIFIED" or Event Name Starts with "FILE_CREATED" or Event Name Starts with "FILE_DELETED" or Event Name Starts with "FILE_ATTRIBBUTE_MODIFIED" or Event Name Starts with "ACL_MODIFIED" or Event Name Starts with "FILE_RENAMED" or Event Name Starts with "FILE_ATTR_CLEAR" or Event Name Starts with "FILE_ATTR_SET" or Event Name Equals "FILE_READ_UPDATE") and Event Generated Time Is within the last 3 Months)
